verdicts.evidence: 10-seed experiments with K=3 sources, n_k=2000, alpha=0.1 on the paper's Linear DGP show MDCP worst-case coverage of 0.905 (classification) and 0.909 (regression), both above the 0.90 nominal level, with results stored in res_clf.json and res_reg.json.

500 seeded finite-measure LP instances (3 sources, 24 outcomes, alpha=0.1) solved via scipy.optimize.linprog show max primal-dual gap 2.23e-8, max complementary-slackness error 2.23e-8, max superlevel-structure violation 1.26e-8, and 500/500 instances with at least one active source, directly confirming the dual structure, KKT conditions, and complementary slackness.

8 sample sizes (100–25,000) × 20 seeds on 64-outcome categorical distributions show sup shared-score error falling from 3.92 to 0.392 (Spearman −1.000) and calibrated-set symmetric difference from 18.45 to 1.80 (within oracle boundary of 3); a destructive control freezing dual weights at smallest-sample estimate yields 2.34× worse error, confirming consistent dual-weight estimation is load-bearing.

Fitted-lambda experiments measured only 4.73% set-size reduction (SE 1.68) vs the claimed 34.39%; even a cheating oracle over constant-lambda directions achieved only 13.49%, while a key deviation (full-batch Adam instead of the paper's minibatch Adam with early stopping) was not implemented and the official 100-trial panel has not completed.

Fitted-lambda experiments measured only 8.71% reduction (SE 1.85) vs the claimed 22.44%; the oracle constant-lambda search achieved 11.91%, still far below the claim, with the same unimplemented optimizer deviation and no completed official 100-trial panel.
No FMoW images, DenseNet-121 checkpoint, or six-region prediction artifacts were used; the logbook explicitly states the claim was not attempted.

overall: The logbook provides strong computational verification for the three theoretical claims (Theorems 1–3) through well-designed experiments with proper controls and machine-precision numerical checks. The two empirical efficiency claims remain inconclusive due to significant optimizer deviations and measured reductions far below the paper's claims, and the FMoW claim was not attempted at all.
